scope: Narrow review of partitioned static geometry, geometry-local to global triangle IDs, 64-bit scene-vertex addressing, existing traffic integration, and standalone validator dependencies.

checks.name: Static descriptor coverage and ordering
checks.detail: Ordered fixed-size sections cover each static triangle once. Each full section spans 1.5 GiB at the current 32-byte SceneVertex stride; only the final section is shorter. Global material/vertex buffers keep their original ordering.

checks.name: Static intersection ID remapping
checks.detail: Both primitive-only and instanced intersection helpers map static geometry-local IDs with geometryID*16,777,216+primitiveID. Swift and Metal partition constants match.

checks.name: Traffic tail remains independent
checks.detail: TLAS instance 0 remains the static city and instance 1 the single traffic geometry. Dynamic hits add staticTriangleCount exactly once. The traffic descriptor and transform output use the same Swift Int byte offset into the shared vertex tail; transform thread indices remain local to that tail. All traffic-capable scene-intersection call sites forward staticTriangles.

checks.name: Global scene-vertex reads use wide indices
checks.detail: The three scene-vertex read sites—glass visibility, primary surface guides and path tracing—cast primitive IDs to ulong before multiplication. Material indices retain global triangle IDs; current material-index storage is well below 4 GiB.

checks.name: Self-test metadata describes actual descriptors
checks.detail: Root-added staticGeometrySections is derived from the exact descriptors submitted for the city build and exposes offsets, triangle counts and byte spans; CommandLine records this list and the shared partition size.

checks.name: Standalone validator dependencies and compilation
checks.detail: All three scripts that explicitly compile MetalRenderer now include GeometryPartition. Traffic --cpu and default Adler CPU checks passed; the paired-motion executable compiled and linked without execution. Shell syntax and diff whitespace checks passed.

currentCityArithmetic.source: Static triangle and traffic counts from existing full-scene CPU/self-test metadata; these are arithmetic expectations, not new GPU observations.

executedChecks.scope: CPU fleet, lane, clock, vertex/light ABI and 13,944 actual mapped placements; exits before Metal device creation.
CPU actual Adler geometry, shell, ABI and navigation; no --gpu/--render flag.

executedChecks.command: xcrun swiftc -O [paired-motion production source list, including GeometryPartition.swift] Tests/PairedMotion/main.swift -o [temporary executable]
executedChecks.scope: Compile and link only; the executable was not run.

references.title: Apple: Explore bindless rendering in Metal
references.supports: Intersection geometry_id identifies the geometry and primitive_id the primitive within it.

references.title: Apple: Metal Shading Language Specification
references.supports: Intersection-result fields and ulong scalar type; sections 2.17.4 and 2.1.

limitations: This review does not establish a universal 4 GiB acceleration-descriptor hardware limit. Partitioning is a conservative bound; root GPU checks determine the actual rendering repair.
Descriptor coverage calculations are CPU arithmetic/source checks; no acceleration structure was built by this reviewer.
Actual large-buffer static/traffic hit mapping, rendered materials, guide positions, and GPU runtime remain root-owned validation.
